pose: neutral balanced biped, tail horizontal, long forearms held apart
anatomy: three-fingered long arms, modest cranial ridge and simple filamented outline
filament_note: Simple narrow branching tufts. Distribution away from distal tail and posterior mandible is an artistic inference. No aerodynamic vanes.
forelimb_note: Three separately modelled digits on each inward-facing hand; digit III slender but not shortened to a vestigial nub.
